caption: The drawing depicts a small, basket-shaped object with two bird figures forming the handle. The basket is colored in shades of brown and beige, with a pattern of red and white decorations on its body. The birds, positioned symmetrically on either side, have dark brown wings, lighter brown bodies, and black spots on their heads and beaks, facing each other at the top center of the object. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a faint inscription "Roy S. Brown" below the object. The entire composition is centered on the page.
title: Chalkware Birds
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
